method: whole conversations ordered by sha256(salt, NUL, conversation id) ascending; first ceil(n * dev_fraction) are dev
note: Split before any system ran on BEAM; sealed conversations are supporting evidence at decisions and report aggregates until retired.

reservations.reason: about 500k tokens per conversation forces at least four compactions at a 32k window (roughly 15); the LongMemEval-M haystacks carry the same 500 questions as LongMemEval-S, which are all dev, and BEAM-1M sealed stays in reserve for a confirmation or a second decision
